title: Bahinemo languages
text: The Bahinemo languages, part of the Sepik Hill branch of the Sepik family spoken in northern Papua New Guinea, are characterized by relatively simple phonological systems with moderate-sized consonant inventories and small vowel sets, lacking lexical tone across the subfamily.
